metaTitle: Honeymoon packages for India and abroad | Comfort Journey
metaDesc: Plan honeymoon packages around your dates, style and budget. Comfort Journey shares clear quotes, private cab options and WhatsApp help for every trip.
heroSubline: Pick the place, share your dates, and let the two of you debate sunset dinners versus mountain views. We will sort the travel details.
whatsAppMsg: Hi Comfort Journey, we are planning a honeymoon or anniversary trip. Please share couple packages, dates, and a clear quote for two.
packagesIntro: Compare island days, hill air and palace stays. We can adjust dates, hotels and pace after you choose a favourite.
storyHeading: Your best planning meeting can be a date
storyParagraphs: A honeymoon or anniversary trip should leave room for the good debates: beach or hills, late breakfast or early photos, one more dessert or two. Tell us what you both enjoy, your dates, and your comfort level. We build the plan around the way you like to travel, then share the details clearly.

Comfort Journey has planned travel from Bhopal since 1992. You get a real person on WhatsApp or phone at +91 92039 31912, including 24/7 support during the trip. Choose a 3-star, 4-star or 5-star hotel, a palace or a villa, then leave the driving to a private cab and driver.

For an international celebration, we can help with visa steps and shape the itinerary around your time together. The quote comes upfront, so you can spend your planning energy on the fun part: choosing what to wear for the first photo.

quickAnswer.question: How do I choose honeymoon packages that suit us?
quickAnswer.answer: Start with the mood you both want: beaches, hills, palaces or a city break. Then share your dates, preferred hotel level and budget. Comfort Journey can customise the itinerary, arrange a private cab with driver, and help with visas for international trips. You receive an upfront quote and can ask questions on WhatsApp before booking.

faqs.q: Which destinations work well for a honeymoon in India?
faqs.a: Kashmir suits couples who want mountain views, while Andaman and Goa bring beach time. Rajasthan adds palace stays and heritage, so you can compare the mood before choosing.

faqs.q: Can you customise a couple tour package?
faqs.a: Yes. Every itinerary can be customised around your dates, interests, hotel choice and preferred pace. Tell us what both of you want to make time for, and we will shape the route around it.

faqs.q: What changes the price of a honeymoon package?
faqs.a: The destination, travel dates, hotel category, number of nights, transport and requested extras all affect the price. Exact quotes are shared on WhatsApp after we understand your plan.

faqs.q: Can we choose a villa, palace or a particular hotel level?
faqs.a: You can choose from 3-star to 5-star hotels, as well as palaces and villas. We will discuss availability, location and budget before sharing suitable options.

faqs.q: Do you provide visa assistance for international honeymoons?
faqs.a: Yes, visa assistance is available for international trips. Our team can explain the process and the documents needed for the destination you select.

faqs.q: Can we reach someone during our trip?
faqs.a: Yes. Real people are available on WhatsApp or phone at +91 92039 31912, with 24/7 support during trips. You can contact the team when a travel detail needs a quick answer.

finalHeading: Ready to plan your two-person escape?
finalText: Send your dates and preferred mood on WhatsApp. We will reply with fitting packages and a clear quote.
